question: Pathans in North-West India organised the society of Khudai Khidmatgars, popularly known as Red Shirt, under whose leadership?
solution:
The correct option is __**Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan:-**

 
 
• He was also known as** Bacha Khan.**
 
• **Khudai Khidmatgars** was a **non-violent movement** founded by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan in **1929** in the** North-West Frontier Province of British India** (now Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan).
 
• The movement was aimed at **promoting social reforms **and **political freedom **through peaceful means.
 
• The members of the movement wore** red shirts** as a symbol of their** unity and commitment to the cause.**
 
• Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan was a **Pashtun nationalist, a devout Muslim,** and a **close associate **of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• He was also known as the **"Frontier Gandhi"** for his commitment to **non-violence** and his work towards **Hindu-Muslim unity.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Ali:-**

 
 
• He was a prominent leader of the** Indian National Congress **and a supporter of the **Khilafat movement.**
 
 
 
• **MA Ansar:-**
 
 
• He was a **Muslim scholar **and a** leader of the Khilafat movement**. 
 
 
 
• **Hasrat Mohan:-**
 
 
• He was a **poet and a political activist** who was associated with the **Indian National Congress** and the **Communist Party of India.**
